Mira.role: Fictional aviation transactions lawyer who follows an edit through the operative clause, schedules and release instructions.

Leo.role: Fictional fleet operator who challenges timing, cash assumptions and whether a concession works on the day.

extra_rules: 7. Label hypothetical exercises as hypothetical. Distinguish observations in a filed clause from estimates of leverage. Give precise commercial instructions. Preserve the difference between approval, obligation and evidence. Only speak financial amounts and time limits from the supplied course text. Make both voices sound natural. Finish at the three takeaways. Do not forecast next week’s topic or read quiz options aloud. Use plain commercial language. Teach through public filings and clearly fictional scenarios. Invent a different business problem when replacing private deal material. Keep private negotiations, walkthroughs and identifying facts out of the dialogue.
